full_judgment: 6. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, the learned Advocate-on-record appearing for the petitioner submits all the D.Ws. are witnesses regarding the divorce of Ismail Shaikh to Kanchan Bewa and there is no legal value of hearsay evidence inasmuch as without complying with the provisions of section 7 of Muslim Family Laws Ordinance, 1961 the talaq is not acted upon, hence the judgment and order of the Single Bench of the High Court Division are liable to he set aside.
